thread:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up: Vertexica renewal in 5 weeks. Usage for their QA/auto-tagging feature plunged and procurement is testing RivalCo. Need fast triage and retention plan.

Omar (CS Ops): Noted. Metrics show tag API calls down ~67% starting 2026-03-12. Auth keys: vertexica-main. No 5xx spikes in logs.

Rhea (AE): Procurement said RivalCo is offering a price-first pilot. CFO asked for a short comparative brief (cost + SLA + demo). Can we get p95 latency and a cost delta?

Sam (Infra): I can pull p95 and model routing. Quick ask: do we have sample request IDs or device IDs to inspect?

Nina (CSM): I'll DM some request IDs. Primary admin changed from Leo (Prod Lead) -> Priyanka (Procurement). She wants a crisp ROI doc.

Omar (CS Ops): Ran a quick query: embedding->tag route calls down 69%, average throughput per device down 55%. No error uptick.

Sam (Infra): If no errors, likely client-side change or SDK tweak. I'll diff tenant config for toggles like client_cache or batch hints.

Jules (CSE): Suggest immediate low-effort play: enable server-side caching on tag hotpaths and a canary to bump batch_max for their tenant. We can show latency & token reductions quickly.

Rhea (AE): I'll draft the brief: three slides — current state, quick fixes (canary + caching), and pilot offer (2-week reserved at reduced rate). Need numbers for unit cost and p95.

Omar (CS Ops): Confirmed: tenant config change on 2026-03-11 set client_batch_override=true which drops server batching. That matches the timeline.

Nina (CSM): Ok, plan: 1) Canary override (Sam) 2) Cost slide + pilot terms (Rhea) 3) Client outreach and pre-read (Nina) 4) Book demo (calendar-bot).

Sam (Infra): Canary config snippet I'll use on canary:
```
tenant_patch {
 id: "vertexica"
 tag_batch_max: 64
 prefix_cache_tags: enabled
}
```
I'll monitor p95 and revert if errors.

Omar (CS Ops): Internal test numbers: enabling prefix cache reduces tokens by ~33% on tag flows; latency improved p95 by ~18%.

Rhea (AE): If canary shows similar gains, I'll propose pilot terms: 14 days reserved capacity, metric targets: tag recall >= 0.85, p95 <= 150ms, plus a 10% reserved discount.

Nina (CSM): I'll reach out to Priyanka to request RivalCo evaluation criteria and their decision date. Need to know if price is sole driver.

Sam (Infra): Canary started. First 45m: p95 down 20% on tag route, mean latency down 26%, batch sizes increased from avg 8->48. No errors.

Jules (CSE): I'll prepare a brief enablement note for the client: recommended SDK patterns (server batching for online paths, local cache for offline), plus a quick checklist.

Rhea (AE): Shared draft brief to thread. Includes unit-cost estimates and projected savings if caching stays.

calendar-bot: Tentative demo slot: Vertexica retention sync  Wed 2026-03-24 11:00 PT.

Nina (CSM): Action recap: Sam - complete 24h canary trace; Omar - pull token-savings graph; Rhea - finalize pilot brief and pricing; Nina - client outreach to Priyanka + book demo.

Omar (CS Ops): 24h canary summary will be up in ~2h. Initial delta promising.

Sam (Infra): 24h canary: p95 -22%, token throughput +38%, cache hit from 14%->60% on tag endpoints. Posting CSV link in client pre-read.

Nina (CSM): Great work. I'll send the pre-read with canary data and proposed pilot terms to Priyanka by EOD. Next check-in in thread tomorrow. Thanks all.

Rhea (AE): :thumbsup: If we can show the end-to-end savings and maintain recall, we should retain them.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: Vertexica retention sync  Wed 2026-03-24 11:00 PT (tentative).
